qualification: Normal expansion measures root top/bottom margins independently of the changing root height and fixed parent gaps.
Reorder changes one keyed native boundary around a memoized retained expanded row. Measured boundary placement qualifies the stages.
Return starts only after the first endpoint. Reversal starts from an observed intermediate presentation and requires two correctly placed intermediate samples moving in the reverse direction.
The same native root/boundary tags, fixed root height and body-local counter are retained. The actual v2 owned root and healthy native runtime are required.
limits: This establishes bounded native geometry for default and forwarding roots on this simulator snapshot.
It does not establish every painted frame, browser-identical animation-start latency or GPU/performance deadlines.
Android runtime, conditional inherited text paint, wider accessibility matrices and calibrated Release performance remain separate gates.
